notes.note: Reviewed the capture-content corruption control after upgrading the fixture to a complete PNG. The route test now flips one byte in a same-length copy after a successful authorized content read, so the byte-length guard cannot substitute for digest verification. It retains the real file, SQLite metadata, restart, Task isolation and contract-region checks. Public failure payload serialization and the earlier scoped capture documentation review are unchanged. Final behavior and fault receipts are reported separately; no real browser/provider or UI qualification is claimed.
